北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，体感 31℃。出行注意交通安全，小心驾驶哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has fog, feels like 31℃. Drive safely and take care!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 35℃ 偏热，多云天气，记得多补水防晒！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels hot at 35℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴热，体感 36℃。记得防晒补水，别中暑哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and hot, feels like 36℃. Stay cool and hydrated!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 92%。闷热感强，注意除湿，保持舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid at 92%. Stay comfortable and dehumidify.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨，湿度 95%。出门带伞，路面湿滑，小心慢行！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain and high humidity. Take an umbrella and watch for wet roads!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 31℃。气温适中，注意防晒和舒适着装。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 31℃. Dress comfortably and stay protected from the sun.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 33℃。天气较热，记得多喝水，注意休息。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels like 33℃. It's warm, so stay hydrated and rest up.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴天，湿度 100%！闷热感重，请注意除湿防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny with 100% humidity! It's muggy, so dehumidify and stay dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴热，体感 35℃。注意防暑，多补水，避免长时间户外活动。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and hot, feels like 35℃. Stay hydrated and avoid prolonged outdoor activity.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安小雨，湿度 95%。出门带伞，地面湿滑，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an has light rain and high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for wet roads.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 23℃。湿度 88%，户外活动注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 23℃. High humidity, stay mindful of dampness outdoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，湿度 92%。体感 27℃，户外注意防潮防晒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and humid at 92%. Feels like 27℃, mind dampness and sun.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 33℃。紫外线强，注意防晒和及时补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 33℃. Strong UV, use sunscreen and hydrate well.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，体感 19℃。湿度 98%，出门带伞，注意保暖防潮。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, feels like 19℃ with 98% humidity. Bring an umbrella, stay warm and dry.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 31℃。湿度高，驾驶请减速慢行，注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has fog and feels like 31℃. High humidity, drive slowly and safely.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴天，体感 30℃。阳光正好，出行注意防晒补水。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and feels like 30℃. Enjoy the sun, but stay hydrated and protected!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 30℃。湿度 80%，户外活动注意防晒补水。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 30℃ with 80% humidity. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen outdoors.
